lines.text: Many learners say: Can you borrow me your pen?
Better: Can you lend me your pen?
Lend means give for a short time.
Lend! Can you lend me some money?

data.wrong: Can you borrow me your pen?
data.right: Can you lend me your pen?
data.why: Lend means give for a short time.
data.memory: Can you lend me your pen?

native.tip: Türkçede ikisi de “ödünç” ile söylenir; birine vermek “lend”, birinden almak “borrow” olur: “Can you lend me your pen?”
native.caption: “Can you borrow me your pen?” mi diyorsun? 😅 Birine vermek “lend”, birinden almak “borrow” olur. Doğrusu “Can you lend me your pen?” Ama’yı dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.

en.tip: Use “lend” to give, “borrow” to take: “Can you lend me your pen?”
en.caption: Do you say “Can you borrow me your pen?” 😅 We say “lend” when we give and “borrow” when we take. The right sentence is “Can you lend me your pen?” Listen to Ama and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
